detail: Trace: plugin/hooks/subagent-stop-hook.sh:42 writes "Subagent completed: ${AGENT_LABEL}" where AGENT_LABEL can be the unbounded `description` field (new 1.11.0 fallback) → src/engine/pending-processor.ts:63 calls BlackboardEngine.post() raw → post() throws INVALID_INPUT at >200 chars (src/engine/blackboard.ts) → drainSwappedFile catch (pending-processor.ts:216-218) logs to stderr and skips → rmSync(swapPath) at :221 deletes the batch — post permanently lost. Reproduced with a 210-char summary: 1 of 2 posts processed, long one gone. Not a regression (old startup drain behaved the same, and old hook labels were always short), but the new description fallback opens the window, and it contradicts the release theme (truncate-don't-reject, no silent loss). Cheap fix: truncate summary in the drain handler in pending-processor.ts (server-side covers old plugin versions too; no token-budget cost). Severity: LOW — narrow reachability, stderr-logged. Everything else green: 1037 tests pass, tsc/build clean, token budget 73B headroom, both manifests 1.11.0, 35 tools (0 new), issues #30-#35 filed, decisions A-G all implemented.
summary: 1.24 integration review: drain path lacks T2 truncation — >200-char pending post (hook description fallback) throws in post(), is skipped, swap deleted = silent permanent loss. Confirmed empirically.
